`.coderabbit.yaml` | Adds CodeRabbit configuration enabling automated reviews for non-draft PRs, UX options (high_level_summary, review_status, collapse_walkthrough, auto_reply), targeted path_instructions for manifests/models/i18n/telemetry, and path_filters to exclude build outputs, deps, snapshots, and select YAML charts.| |**IDE / contributor rulebook**
`.cursor/rules/networking-console-plugin.mdc` | New Cursor rules document specifying plugin conventions: component/import patterns, i18n requirements, routing (react-router v7), prohibition on `console.*`, styling rules (no hex colors), feature-flag expectations, view-folder layout, and Cypress e2e guidance.| |**High-level architecture & integration**
`ARCHITECTURE.md` | Documents system context, plugin registration via `plugin-manifest.ts`, managed Kubernetes resource kinds, feature-flag gating (NAD/UDN), runtime CRD probing, Console SDK data flows (watch/create/patch/delete), build/dev and production bundling/deployment, and CI/CD notes.| |**Contributor onboarding & standards**
`CONTRIBUTING.md`, `README.md` | Rewrites README for the networking-plugin (prereqs, quick start, dev container, scripts, path aliases, i18n via `useNetworkingTranslation`, styling rules, Docker/Helm deploy, testing). CONTRIBUTING.md adds coding standards, PR/workflow expectations (Prow/OWNERS), i18n validation, testing commands, and commit/PR formatting.| |**Agent/quick-reference docs & checklist**
`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | Adds AGENTS.md with repository structure, view-module pattern (actions/details/form/manifest), SDK/telemetry/routing/feature-flag conventions, and a review checklist.
